events.title: Mick Jagger turns 83
events.blurb: Sir Michael Philip Jagger, lead singer of The Rolling Stones, was born on July 26, 1943, in Dartford, Kent, England.

angles.name: Rock Legend's Birthday
angles.copy: Eighty-three years young today! We're celebrating the legendary Mick Jagger, still strutting his stuff and proving that rock 'n' roll never gets old. What's your favourite Stones track?

events.title: MTV launched, 45 years ago
events.blurb: Music Television (MTV) launched on August 1, 1981, with The Buggles' 'Video Killed The Radio Star' as its very first music video.

angles.name: MTV's Big Birthday
angles.copy: Forty-five years ago, a channel launched that changed music forever. MTV hit our screens on August 1st, 1981, kicking off with The Buggles. What was the first music video that truly blew your mind?

events.title: Oasis' 'Definitely Maybe' turns 32
events.blurb: Oasis released their debut studio album 'Definitely Maybe' on August 29, 1994, featuring iconic tracks like 'Live Forever' and 'Supersonic'.

angles.name: Definitely Maybe Anniversary
angles.copy: Thirty-two years since Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe' and changed the game. From Manchester to the world, this album is pure Britpop gold. Which track still gets you every time?

events.title: Woodstock Festival: 57 years on
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal event in 1960s counterculture, took place from August 15-18, 1969, in Bethel, New York.

angles.name: Remembering Woodstock
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, half a million people gathered for '3 Days of Peace & Music' at Woodstock. A defining moment for a generation and music history. If you could have been there, which artist would you have seen?

events.title: Anniversary of Elvis Presley's passing
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the 'King of Rock and Roll', passed away on August 16, 1977.

angles.name: Tribute to The King
angles.copy: Remembering Elvis Presley today, 49 years since we lost the King of Rock and Roll. His music and legacy continue to inspire generations. What's your all-time favourite Elvis hit?

events.title: Anniversary of Tupac Shakur's passing
events.blurb: Tupac Shakur, an influential rapper, was shot in Las Vegas on September 7, 1996, and died six days later on September 13, 1996.

angles.name: Tupac Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering Tupac Shakur today, 30 years since his tragic passing. His impact on music and culture remains undeniable. What's the one Tupac track that speaks to you most?

events.title: Anniversary of Jimi Hendrix's passing
events.blurb: Jimi Hendrix, widely regarded as one of the greatest guitarists in history, passed away on September 18, 1970.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled genius of Jimi Hendrix today, 56 years since his passing. A true guitar icon whose influence is still felt across music. Which of his solos gives you goosebumps?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic 'Abbey Road' album in the UK on September 26, 1969, and in the US on October 1, 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That zebra crossing, those timeless tracks… it’s an album that defined a generation. What’s your favourite side one or side two moment?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Christine Ellen Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, was born on September 7, 1951, in Akron, Ohio, USA.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! The Pretenders frontwoman, still rocking and inspiring. What's your go-to Pretenders anthem?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: William John Paul Gallagher, best known as the frontman of Oasis, was born on September 21, 1972, in Manchester, England.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher's Birthday
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54 today! Happy Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. Still bringing the rock 'n' roll swagger. What's your favourite Liam moment, musical or otherwise?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' single turns 55
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic single 'Imagine' was released in the US on October 11, 1971, and in the UK in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine 55th Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. A timeless message of peace that resonates just as strongly today. What does this song mean to you?

events.title: The first iPod was released 25 years ago
events.blurb: Apple introduced the first-generation iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising portable music players.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember shuffling through your entire music library in your pocket? The first iPod dropped 25 years ago today, changing how we listen to music forever. What was the first song you loaded onto yours?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the release of the first James Bond film, 'Dr. No', on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond Day
angles.copy: Grab your martini, shaken not stirred! It's James Bond Day, celebrating 007's cinematic debut. Who's your favourite Bond, and what's the best Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Winston Ono Lennon, co-founder of The Beatles, was born on October 9, 1940, in Liverpool, England, and tragically passed away in 1980.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the iconic John Lennon. His music and message of peace continue to inspire the world. What's your most cherished Lennon song?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: John Marwood Cleese, the acclaimed English actor, comedian, and screenwriter, was born on October 27, 1939, in Weston-super-Mare, Somerset.

angles.name: John Cleese's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the comedy legend, John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his wit is timeless. What's your favourite John Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles dropped 'The White Album'. A double LP packed with incredible diversity and genius. What are your standout tracks from this iconic record?
